brief:
Pull FedWiki timeline pages and render formal executive-brief PDFs - one brief per timeline plus a combined dossier whose "Unified Summary" layer is built from the In-brief summaries. Use when turning the *.timeline.ide.earth subdomain wikis (or any same-shaped FedWiki answer pages) into shareable, executive-style PDF documents.

Turns the federated timeline wikis into formal PDF documents. Source of truth is the **live** `*.timeline.ide.earth` subdomains, read over public GET (no cookie needed).

The **Unified Summary** section is deliberate: it is the shared semantic core (each milestone compressed to its five answers) from which the detailed sections - and any community-specific retelling produced by the `understanding-compression` skill - expand.
